notes: 'which' and 'but' are both supplied over asyndetic clauses with no relative or waw in the Hebrew; each is its own added unit since ASV-rendered material stands between them (rules 14, 46, 55).
'cannot' goes whole to לֹא with no יָכֹל in the clause (rule 35); copula 'Are' joins the prepositional predicate כְּ (rule 49).
